$comment: Generated by scripts/schemas from trialfolio.contracts.tables.SeriesRow, in serialization mode. Validation and serialization modes give the same schema. Never edit it by hand.
description:
One row of `series.csv`: a `chart` level of the strategy or the benchmark, or a rebalance
period's return of the strategy, the benchmark, or the excess, as the saved response gives
it, with the digits its text has (series.csv).

subject.description: `excess`, the period's `Excess%`, on a period row only.
subject.title: Subject

date.description:
A daily row's `chart` date, or a period row's `End Dt`. Null when the series is
unavailable, or the date can't be read.
date.title: Date

period_start.description: A period row's `Tran Dt`. Null on a daily row, and when it can't be read.
period_start.title: Period Start

value.description:
The level, or the return in percent, as a normalized decimal with the digits the saved text
has. Null when unavailable.
value.title: Value

unit.description: `index` on a daily row, `percent` on a period row.
unit.title: Unit

source_decimals.description: The digits after the decimal point, as saved. Null when unavailable.
source_decimals.title: Source Decimals

source_location.description:
The value's JSON path in the response. Null when the whole series is unavailable, or the
column is missing.
source_location.title: Source Location

title: SeriesRow
